---
title: "Electrical System Losses"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r, echo = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr)
library(janitor)
library(downloadthis)
library(data.table)
library(keyring)

options(scipen = 999)

eia_key <- key_get("eia_api")

call_url <- 
  paste0(
    "https://api.eia.gov/v2/seds/data/?frequency=annual&data[0]=value&api_key=",
    eia_key, 
    "&facets[seriesId][]=LOTCB&facets[stateId][]=MN&start=2004&sort[0][column]=period&sort[0][direction]=asc&offset=0&length=5000"
  )

energy_losses <- GET(call_url)

energy_losses <- fromJSON(rawToChar(energy_losses$content))

energy_losses <- energy_losses$response$data |> 
  tibble() |> 
  # rename(loss_billion_btu = value, 
  #        year = period) |> 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(period),
         loss_billion_btu = as.numeric(value)) |> 
  select(year, loss_billion_btu)

loss_goal <- energy_losses |> 
  filter(year == 2005) |> 
  mutate(goal = loss_billion_btu * .85) |> 
  pull(goal)

graph_max <- energy_losses |> 
  filter(loss_billion_btu == max(loss_billion_btu)) |> 
  mutate(graph_max = loss_billion_btu * 1.1) |> 
  pull(graph_max)

graph_min <- .7 * loss_goal

annotate_x <- energy_losses |> 
  filter(year == min(year)) |> 
  mutate(annotate_x = year + 1) |> 
  pull(annotate_x)

annotate_y <- loss_goal * 1.015

p <- energy_losses |> 
  ggplot() + aes(x = year, y = loss_billion_btu) + geom_line(color = "#003865", linewidth = 1) + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black")) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = loss_goal) +
  annotate("text", x = annotate_x, y = annotate_y, label = "2030 Goal") +
  ylim(graph_min, graph_max) + 
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Billion BTU") + 
  ggtitle("Measure 4.5 - By 2030, reduce energy use by 10% and total \nwaste heat and waste electricity by 15%, compared to 2005 levels")

p

suppressMessages(
 energy_losses |> 
  download_this(
    output_name = "Electrical System Energy Loss", 
    output_extension = ".xlsx", 
    button_label = "Download Data",
    button_type = "success", 
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )
)

suppressMessages(
 p |> 
  download_this(
    output_name = "Minnesota Total Electrical System Energy Losses", 
    output_extension = ".png", 
    button_label = "Download Plot",
    button_type = "success", 
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )
)

```
